import pandas as pd
files=['airlines/DL.csv','airlines/UA.csv']
rows=[]
for f in files:
 d=pd.read_csv(f)
 dt=pd.to_datetime(d['date'], errors='coerce')
 keep=dt.between('2025-01-01','2025-02-28')
 print(f,'kept',keep.sum(),'bad dates',dt.isna().sum(),'outside',(~keep & dt.notna()).sum())
 x=d.loc[keep].copy()
 x['route']=x.apply(lambda r:'-'.join(sorted([str(r['origin']),str(r['dest'])])),axis=1)
 rows.append(x)
allx=pd.concat(rows,ignore_index=True)
counts=allx['route'].value_counts().sort_index().sort_values(ascending=False, kind='stable')
# tie alpha explicitly
counts=counts.rename_axis('route').reset_index(name='count').sort_values(['count','route'], ascending=[False,True])
print('total',len(allx),'unique',allx['flight_id'].nunique(),'rows duplicate ids',allx['flight_id'].duplicated().sum())
print(counts.to_string(index=False))
import json
print(json.dumps({'route_counts':dict(zip(counts.route,counts['count'])),'total_flights':int(len(allx))},separators=(',',':')))

import pandas as pd, json
wn=pd.read_csv('airlines/WN.csv'); as_=pd.read_csv('airlines/AS.csv')
wn['flight_date']=pd.to_datetime(wn['date'], errors='coerce'); as_['flight_date']=pd.to_datetime(as_['date_utc'], errors='coerce')
start=pd.Timestamp('2025-01-01'); end=pd.Timestamp('2025-02-28')
wnf=wn[wn.flight_date.between(start,end)].copy(); asf=as_[as_.flight_date.between(start,end)].copy()
allf=pd.concat([wnf,asf], ignore_index=True)
allf['route']=allf.apply(lambda r:'-'.join(sorted([str(r.origin),str(r.dest)])),axis=1)
counts=allf['route'].value_counts().to_dict()
counts=dict(sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda x:(-x[1],x[0])))
out={'route_counts':counts,'total_flights':len(allf)}
print('WN',len(wnf),'AS',len(asf),'total',len(allf),'unique flight ids',allf.flight_id.nunique(),'rows',len(allf))
print(json.dumps(out))
